note: dsh's web client bundles only the Montserrat brand font; its text stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', ...) resolves to whatever the machine has. Both parity providers therefore pin the same Latin face under the stack's leading names that no Linux machine has (`-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`, `Segoe UI`): the React provider serves the files through @font-face, the Flutter provider registers them with FontLoader (flutter_test ignores a font fallback list when the primary family is unknown, so the leading names must exist). Weights 500/600 resolve to the nearest face (Regular below 500, Bold from 600) on both sides.
notVendored: Montserrat (dsh brand wordmark, OFL, woff2 in ui-theme/src/styles): Flutter cannot load woff2; needed only once a case shows the wordmark.
CJK (PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei stack entries): needed when the first zh-CN case is added.
